description: This file contains unit tests for TalkModeConfigParsing, validating configuration parsing and default handling in the TalkModeRuntime component.

classes.name: TalkModeConfigParsingTests
classes.description: A test suite for validating parsing and fallback logic in TalkModeRuntime configurations.

methods.name: `rejects normalized talk provider payload without resolved`
methods.description: Tests that parsing fails when normalized talk provider payload lacks 'resolved' field.

methods.name: `falls back to legacy talk fields when normalized payload missing`
methods.description: Ensures fallback to legacy fields occurs when normalized payload data is missing.

methods.name: `reads configured silence timeout ms`
methods.description: Checks that configured silence timeout is correctly read from the payload.

methods.name: `defaults silence timeout ms when missing`
methods.description: Verifies that default silence timeout is used when none is specified.

methods.name: `defaults silence timeout ms when invalid`
methods.description: Ensures fallback to default when an invalid silence timeout value is provided.
